# Week 1 task

Publish your starter assistant and tell us how you built it.

In your submission include a link to your repository, a link to your running assistant (the demo
link), and a short reflection.

<!-- marking-table v1 -->
| Criterion | Points | Full marks when | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| Working demo | 10 | Demo link opens and the assistant answers a test question | http_ok:demo_url |
| Repository and README | 8 | The repository clones and the README has a Setup section | repo_clone; readme_sections:Setup |
| Reflection | 7 | 150+ words on what you built and what went wrong | word_count:150 |
<!-- /marking-table -->
